question: The mean of the first 7 odd prime numbers is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The first 7 odd prime numbers are 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, and 19.

Sum = 3 + 5 + 7 + 11 + 13 + 17 + 19 = 75

Mean = Sum ÷ Count

⇒ Mean = 75 ÷ 7 = 10.714...

**∴ The correct answer is 10.71.**
